scope: repository P2 configs, runners, reports, and tests; artifacts/submissions/raw data excluded

selected_axis.single_change: append the masked mean of element-embedding self-products to the exact v13 masked mean, masked maximum, and context before the unchanged head
selected_axis.historical_support: v13 executed all three prefix-purged folds; every selected scoring row has a finite public-token mask and the diagonal self-product is finite with zero for absent support; training rows are 45935, 119667, and 149384
selected_axis.identity_initialization: the new 32 head columns are exactly zero and the original 75 head columns are copied, so the initial function equals v13

distinctions.v15: self-attention mixes pairs of tokens before pooling; v48 has no attention and aggregates only each token embedding's diagonal self-product
distinctions.v16: physical-depth graph messaging uses depth edges and neighbor messages; v48 has no graph, adjacency, or depth kernel
distinctions.v20: CORAL aligns full centered latent covariance across calendar-month environments as a loss; v48 uses an uncentered diagonal second moment as a predictive profile descriptor and adds no alignment loss
distinctions.v45_v45c: DropConnect masks Linear weights during training; v48 is deterministic and changes only the pooled profile statistic
distinctions.v46: LayerNorm normalizes hidden activations per example; v48 performs no normalization
distinctions.v47: CrossNet creates explicit interactions among already pooled mean/max/context coordinates; v48 computes a token-level orderless second-order statistic before pooling and has no cross layer

primary_source.citation: Lin, RoyChowdhury, and Maji, Bilinear CNN Models for Fine-Grained Visual Recognition, ICCV 2015
primary_source.claim: outer-product features pooled across locations form an orderless second-order descriptor
primary_source.use: representation motivation only; no P2 performance transfer
